status: Qualified cache replacement optimization; full goal ACTIVE and incomplete

behavior.reservation: Evict only an unpinned victim, remove old key from publication, retain opaque buffers as CACHE-OWNED storage under the existing pending-slot charge. Pending entries cannot be acquired; duplicate reservation is BUSY.
behavior.commit: Refill must finish or be ordered for every consumer before commit. Retained reservation can commit only its exact borrowed tuple. Ownership never transfers to the borrower.
behavior.abort: Abort destroys retained buffers, including poisoned partial refills, then clears the reservation. Layout changes must discard old storage BEFORE allocating replacements. Stale tickets are rejected.
behavior.compatibility: Regular reserve retains its original destroy-on-eviction behavior. Native stores select the new path only when the backend supports synchronous refill; other backends keep existing behavior.
behavior.native_bridge: Per-slot CPU layout metadata tracks context-compatible format/k/n/marker/offset/bytes. Layout mismatch discards old storage before creation. Failed refill aborts without publishing and without double-free. Model anatomy and CPU weights remain immutable; generic cache owns LRU/hash/lease transitions.
behavior.synchronization: Existing request completion before lease release and synchronous upload publication to nonblocking consumer streams are unchanged. No new GPU kernels, changed arithmetic, routing, grouping or head geometry.

workload.profile: Explicit Diffbot INT4 BF16 lookup -> Exllama F16 Engram execution adapter; not original Diffbot full-runtime equivalence
workload.fixture: Fresh513 + resumed513 + five self-fed source greedy tokens; context1031/maxseq1280/f16acc0
workload.measurement: Monotonic host time for input history staging through completed CPU-logit publication; preparation and exact verification excluded; no observer callbacks in plain timing runs.
workload.limitations: OS page-cache/disk warmth and clocks uncontrolled. Fixed sequence replay, not general serving arrivals, disk-cold behavior, whole-checkpoint VRAM residency or vLLM parity.

memory.maximum_pending_charge: Published plus pending entries never exceed existing cache capacity; retained storage overlaps the pending entry charge, not a new pool/budget.
memory.notes: Trace is the small-VRAM case. Allocation peak excludes untracked driver/context/rounding overhead and is not compared with the prior large-VRAM trace.

qualification.scope: Cache-owned recycled decode-LRU reservations and native refill: bounded pinned/retained/commit/abort ownership; whole-source CUDA outputs including repeated RAM-warm/48-slot VRAM-miss workload. No vLLM parity or serving admission claim.

validation.cache_units: Existing lease/LRU/bounds tests plus 1000 recycled replacements with a pinned anchor, unpublished pending entries, wrong tuple rejection, stale tickets, explicit discard, poison abort and physical payload bounds
validation.native_units: Pinned refusal, exact replacement bytes, poisoned second projection abort, no publication/leak, successful retry and teardown
validation.cuda_memcheck: 0 errors; 0 bytes leaked in 0 allocations, including small VRAM
